title: 6 Days Restorative Yoga & Healing Retreat in Ubud, Bali
metaTitle: 6-Day Restorative Yoga Retreat in Ubud, Bali
metaDescription: Slow down at a 6-day restorative yoga retreat in Ubud, Bali, with daily breathwork, sound healing, five massages, accommodation and vegetarian meals.
summary: Six restorative days in Ubud with gentle yoga, conscious breathing, sound experiences and daily massage treatments, with meals, accommodation and personal time.
intro: Slow down for six restorative days in Ubud with gentle yoga, conscious breathing, immersive sound experiences and daily massage treatments—all balanced with nourishing meals, comfortable accommodation and plenty of personal time.

This is not an intensive yoga programme. The experience follows a slower arc: gentle movement prepares the body, conscious breath settles attention, sound encourages receptive stillness, massage supports physical relaxation, and unscheduled time lets the day land naturally.
Spaciousness is not an empty part of the timetable—it is part of the retreat. Every day protects time for the pool, reading, journaling, exploring Ubud, taking a nap or simply doing nothing.

curriculum.title: Restorative Yoga
curriculum.summary: Gentle, supported yoga without difficult postures or performance pressure.

curriculum.title: Breathwork
curriculum.summary: Accessible guided breathing practices that beginners can understand and continue after the retreat.

curriculum.title: Sound Healing
curriculum.summary: Restful sound experiences centred on conscious listening, stillness and quiet integration.

curriculum.title: Massage Therapy
curriculum.summary: Five full-body Balinese massages are placed after the day’s practices to complement the retreat’s slower rhythm.

schedule.heading: Choose the room that supports your rest
schedule.note: Retreats are offered year-round, subject to room, teacher and treatment availability. Check dates before booking flights.

fees.note: Price transparency: These are the rates published on Bali Yoga School’s existing six-day Ubud retreat page when this redesign was prepared. Reconfirm the current rate, room, massage availability, exact sound-session count, meals and payment terms before paying.

inclusions: Swimming pool access during campus hours
exclusions: Transport and off-campus activities are not included unless the school confirms otherwise.

dailySchedule.activity: Complete free time, pool and rest

dining.text: Plant-based vegetarian meals complement the retreat’s uncomplicated rhythm. Expect fresh ingredients, fruit and balanced dishes, with vegan options available.

arrival: The campus is in a quieter Ubud setting, approximately a 10-minute ride from the centre—close enough to explore during free time while keeping a residential retreat atmosphere.
prerequisites: Experienced practitioners wanting a slower practice
Guests curious about Breathwork or Sound Healing
Travellers wanting a slower Bali holiday
Anyone seeking more personal space and rest

policies.title: Schedule changes
items: The school may adjust session timings, teachers or sequence while protecting the overall focus and included services.

policies.title: Practice care
items: Tell the teacher about pregnancy, recent surgery, respiratory or cardiovascular conditions, dizziness, anxiety triggers or other relevant concerns before Breathwork or yoga.

policies.title: Wellness disclaimer
items: Sound sessions are educational, contemplative and relaxation-based wellness experiences. They do not diagnose or treat medical or mental-health conditions.

policies.title: Dietary requirements
items: Share allergies and dietary requirements before arrival.
